name: mcode_list_repos
description: List the repositories reachable through a connected GitHub App installation. Pass installation_id (from mcode_list_installations) or omit to use the most recent installation. Returns { installation_id, repos:[{ full_name, default_branch, private, ... }] }. Use full_name (owner/repo) when creating/cloning a workspace.

installation_id.description: Installation to list repos for; omit to use the most recent.
